title: GideonLobby
description: A modern and modular lobby framework built for Paper servers.
body:
# 🦊 GideonLobby

**GideonLobby** is a modern, modular and performance-focused lobby framework designed for Paper servers.

Built from the ground up using modern APIs such as Adventure and MiniMessage, GideonLobby provides server owners with a complete ecosystem for creating immersive and professional lobby experiences without relying on dozens of separate plugins.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🧭 Advanced Navigator

* Server selector GUI.
* Velocity and BungeeCord support.
* Configurable menus.
* Custom actions.
* Sounds and cooldowns.
* Modern menu engine.

### 🎨 Modern Visual System

* Animated scoreboards.
* ActionBars.
* BossBars.
* Join titles.
* Auto announcements.
* MiniMessage support.
* RGB gradients.

### ⚡ Movement Features

* Double Jump.
* Launch Pads.
* Fly Toggle.
* Speed Toggle.
* Configurable lobby movement.

### 🛡️ Lobby Protection

* Block break protection.
* Block place protection.
* PvP protection.
* Hunger protection.
* Mob spawn protection.
* Explosion protection.
* Void protection.
* Permission bypass system.

### 🎭 Animation Engine

Create reusable animations across the entire plugin.

Use animations in:

* Scoreboards
* Menus
* Item names
* Item lore
* BossBars
* ActionBars
* Announcements

### 🌎 Region System

Built-in region support without requiring external plugins.

Examples:

* Spawn regions
* Fly regions
* PvP regions
* LaunchPad regions

### 🔊 Sound Engine

Centralized sound management system.

* Configurable sounds.
* Reusable sound profiles.
* Consistent user experience.

### 📦 Modern GUI Framework

Powerful internal menu engine.

* Pagination support.
* Animated items.
* Placeholder support.
* Reusable menus.
* Dynamic updates.

### 🔗 PlaceholderAPI Integration

Supports placeholders throughout the plugin.

Examples:

* %player_name%
* %player_ping%
* %luckperms_prefix%
* %vault_eco_balance%

And custom GideonLobby placeholders.

### 🌍 Per-World Configuration

Enable or disable features on specific worlds.

Example:

* Double Jump only in lobby.
* Protection only in hub worlds.

---

## 🚀 Built for Modern Servers

GideonLobby is designed for:

* Networks
* Hub Servers
* Minigame Servers
* Survival Networks
* Community Servers
* Premium Projects

Unlike traditional lobby plugins, GideonLobby focuses on scalability, modularity and long-term maintainability.

---

## ⚙️ Modern Architecture

Built using:

* Java 21
* Paper API
* Adventure API
* MiniMessage

No NMS.
No outdated APIs.

---

## 🔌 Optional Integrations

Supported integrations:

* PlaceholderAPI
* LuckPerms
* Vault

The plugin works perfectly even if optional integrations are not installed.

---

## 🦊 Part of the Gideon Ecosystem

GideonLobby is part of the growing Gideon Studio ecosystem.

Future companion projects include:

* GideonChat
* GideonNPC
* GideonCrates

Designed to work together while remaining fully functional on their own.

---

## ❤️ Created by Gideon Studio

Modern software. Modern architecture. Modern Minecraft experiences.
